title: The Psychology of Helping: Why We Step In (Long Listen)
desc: Why do people help strangers, and why do they sometimes hold back? A calm, sourced long listen on the bystander effect and what really happened in the Kitty Genovese case, the seminary students in a hurry, how mood changes kindness, empathy and its limits, toddlers who help, helping across cultures, whose side we are on, rescuers and extraordinary donors, training people to step in, helping online, when helping hurts the helper, the five steps to helping, and help that does not help. It ends with a slow wind-down for sleep. Every claim comes from named studies, and the doubts are left in.
